name: dsh-subagent-compat
description: Compatibility shim that restores the legacy subagents.start(provider, request) API on DSH 0.2.x, where the subagents service exposes startActivation() instead. dsh-swarm-orchestrator 0.6.x still calls the legacy entry point, so without this shim every swarm task agent fails with "subagents.start is not a function".
